name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.crash.CrashActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When BigBrother handles an uncaught app crash, it opens this screen with the page where the crash occurred, the error details, and a session timeline.
disableEffect: The BigBrother crash report screen will not open, so its saved error details cannot be reviewed; the app's normal operation is unaffected.
